title: HSPR: Recovering Software-Agent Benchmark Scores via Hierarchical Posterior Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.24611v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluating software agents on a full benchmark is expensive. A small task subset can preserve agent rankings while yielding inaccurate scores. Historical responses provide useful structure, but tasks with identical source responses can have different outcomes for a new target agent. We introduce Hierarchical Score Posterior Recovery (HSPR), which combines source-fitted response factors with uncertain group success rates. Observed target outcomes update the posteriors over the target latent state and group rates; posterior-guided acquisition selects subsequent tasks. Its score-based criterion equals the expected one-step reduction in full-score posterior variance. Observed successes and posterior-predictive counts for unqueried tasks yield a full-score posterior. The final estimate uses its median with source-selected calibration. At a 10% task budget on four task banks from the SWE-bench family, HSPR achieves the lowest mean absolute

translated_title: HSPR：通过层次后验推断恢复软件智能体基准测试分数
translated_abstract: 在完整基准测试上评估软件智能体的成本很高。小型任务子集虽然能保持智能体的排名，但会产生不准确的分数。历史响应提供了有用的结构信息，然而对于新的目标智能体而言，具有相同源响应的任务可能产生不同的结果。我们提出了层次分数后验恢复（HSPR），它将基于源数据拟合的响应因子与不确定的组成功率相结合。观测到的目标结果会更新目标潜在状态和组成功率的后验分布；后验引导的采集策略用于选择后续任务。其基于分数的准则等同于完整分数后验方差的期望一步缩减量。观测到的成功次数以及未查询任务的后验预测计数共同产生完整分数的后验分布。最终估计采用该后验的中位数，并结合基于源数据选择的校准方法。在来自SWE-bench系列的四个任务库上，以10%的任务预算，HSPR实现了最低的平均绝对误差。
tldr: 提出HSPR方法，利用层次后验推断，仅需10%的任务预算即可从部分评估中准确恢复软件智能体在完整基准测试上的分数。
en_tdlr: HSPR leverages hierarchical posterior inference to accurately recover software-agent full-benchmark scores from partial evaluations using only a 10% task budget.
